blind_answer.reason: The tool descriptions are already well differentiated, so they are not the cause. The system prompt's keyword-triggered instruction ('Whenever a request mentions a report, summarize it first') overrides those descriptions and pushes the subagent toward summarize_content. Rewriting that instruction removes the root cause (2.1-K4, 2.1-S4). Expanding the description (C) treats a symptom. Merging the tools (A) undoes good tool design. Forcing extract_data_points on every request (D) breaks the cases that legitimately need summarize_content or verify_claim_against_source.
